git diff --check && git diff --stat && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = [Path('docs/README.md'), Path('docs/runbooks/README.md'), Path('docs/runbooks/receipts-stopped.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md')]
for path in paths:
    for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        target = link.split('#')[0]
        if target and '://' not in target:
            assert (path.parent / target).is_file(), (path, target)
print('Links in changed docs resolve.')
PY

Added [Receipts stopped](/work/docs/runbooks/receipts-stopped.md), linked from the runbook index and architecture.

It covers checking and starting the worker, monitoring the queue, confirming delivery, handling failures, and escalating with logs. It distinguishes historical bounced emails from new failures.

The missing host details, owner, and alternate contact are explicitly recorded. The deployment fix remains outstanding because its script isn’t in the repository.

Documentation links resolve; both tests pass.
